title: Complex analysis for physics
purpose: Use analyticity and contour methods to evaluate integrals and analyze physical response functions.

blocks.deliverable: Analyze branches of powers and logarithms.
Check analyticity and parametrize elementary contours.
Derive a derivative estimate under stated assumptions.
Week 7 midterm; locate and classify isolated singularities.
Choose a contour and justify the contribution at infinity.
Map a simple domain and track boundaries.
Present all contour assumptions and take an unseen final.

project: Evaluate one real improper integral by residues and verify the numerical value independently.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
